committee.sub: Morning brief · Saturday 14 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: The landing-page test credit is now at $0 (creditRemainingExGst), so the decision rule applies: pause paid search unless cost per qualified enquiry is $480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked. With review_cta_click still at 0 since the test started, no booking exists yet, which lines up with campaignStatus showing PAUSED.
Since the test began, ask_cta_click sits at 19 against review_cta_click at 0 and quick_question_click at 5, so the low-commitment question form keeps being the preferred action on the frozen page.

Three generate_lead events have fired since the test started (eventsSinceStart.generate_lead=3), with sitewide leads at 1 this week versus 2 the week before. These are unverified enquiry candidates, not demand, until graded against the qualified rule.

Organic Search sessions roughly doubled (12 versus 5 prior week) while AI Assistant visits stayed at zero. Search Console data (through 10 Nov, so two days behind) shows the query kontrol ai sitting at position 1 with a click, the only verified unpaid signal this week.

actions.text: Credit remaining has fallen to $0, triggering the pause-or-continue decision: pause unless cost per qualified enquiry is $480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked a review. Confirm this against the test log before any restart.

Raw paid clicks have reached 108, well past the 75-click checkpoint: check the test log now for relevant and qualified counts, since 75+ relevant clicks with zero qualified enquiries fires the red flag. The page stays frozen past click 25, no copy or CTA changes unless something is broken.

Check the Formspree and Cal.com emails behind the three generate_lead events logged since the test started, confirm the traffic source for each, and grade them against the qualified rule (real business, repeatable admin process, named system) in the test log.
Logo and image assets for the serving ad groups (Agency, Job Intake) are still outstanding.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success: update them to match current site stats.
